description: This file is a Lua script that creates a graphical demonstration of various 2D shapes, using functions like createWindow, background, fill, stroke, circle, square, rect, ellipse, translate, rotate, push, pop, and text rendering. It includes a setup function for initialization and a draw loop for rendering animated shapes.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the graphical window with size 600x600 and sets default drawing styles.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Continuously renders animated 2D shapes, including circles, squares, rectangles, and ellipses, with transformations and filled colors, creating an animated shapes display.
